claim: The University of Iceland's application deadline page lists the autumn undergraduate deadline of 5 June under a heading for Icelandic and Nordic citizens, a group that includes a Danish citizen applying from Denmark.
excerpt: Icelandic and Nordic citizens — Undergraduate studies: 5 June
interpretation: Read literally, this makes 5 June the deadline for a Danish applicant, because a Danish citizen is a Nordic citizen. That reading is contradicted by the university's own FAQ, which is recorded separately as ev-hi-is-faq-5-june. This record deliberately does not resolve the two: the convenient reading here is the later deadline, and preferring it is exactly the choice that costs a student a year if it is wrong.

notes: Both this page and the FAQ were read on 2026-09-23 and both were live. The contradiction is the publisher's, not a stale copy on our side.

attestation.by: the deadline research pass, Nordic and Baltic group
attestation.note: Read against the source page on 2026-09-23, alongside the FAQ it contradicts.

claim: The University of Iceland's FAQ gives the same 5 June deadline to international students who have lived in Iceland and are living in Iceland, and does not mention Nordic citizens at all.
excerpt: International students who have lived in Iceland og are living in Iceland — 5 June
interpretation: Read literally, this excludes a Danish applicant applying from Denmark, who has not lived in Iceland. It cannot both be true and ev-hi-is-deadline-page-5-june be true, because the two describe different groups as the one 5 June belongs to. The untranslated Icelandic "og" left in the middle of an English sentence is worth recording: it is what a partial translation that has fallen out of step with the page it contradicts looks like from the outside, and it is a reason to suspect this page is the stale one — but a suspicion is not a fact, and the product declines to state a date on the strength of it.

notes: The resolution is not ours to make. admission@hi.is is the address that can settle it, and the country record tells the student to ask before relying on 5 June.

attestation.by: the deadline research pass, Nordic and Baltic group
attestation.note: Read against the source page on 2026-09-23, alongside the deadline page it contradicts.
